notes.title: Check out the newest Tattoo Tycoon Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
We just dropped a brand-new gameplay trailer as part of the Games Forged In Germany Showcase, and we’re super excited to share it with you!

Get an early glimpse of how you'll build your tattoo empire. Find your style, decorate your studio, bring your customers' ideas to life, and build your tattoo empire to become the next Tattoo Tycoon.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=57VpOhtIrO8

Don't forget to wishlist the game, Tattoo Tycoon is coming very soon!
